items.name: filesystem
items.summary: Read and write files under a directory you nominate.
items.description: The reference filesystem MCP server. Access is limited to the roots passed at install time, so the directory you name here is the whole of what a bound agent can reach.

placeholders.label: Allowed directory
placeholders.description: Absolute path the server may read and write. Everything outside it stays unreachable.

items.name: github
items.summary: Browse repositories, issues, and pull requests on GitHub.
items.description: The GitHub MCP server. It acts as whoever owns the personal access token supplied at install time; scope that token to the repositories the workspace should reach.

placeholders.label: GitHub personal access token
placeholders.description: Stored write-only with the workspace MCP server entry and never returned by any read endpoint.

items.name: fetch
items.summary: Fetch a web page and hand back its content as text.
items.description: The reference fetch MCP server. It takes no credentials, so a bound agent can retrieve public pages and nothing more.

items.name: memory
items.summary: A knowledge graph an agent can write notes into and read back.
items.description: The reference memory MCP server, backed by a local knowledge graph file. Takes no credentials.
